notes.title: Update News: V1.1.0 is here!
notes.content:
Rigid Force Alpha V1.1.0 is now available! With this update you'll get the following new features and improvements:

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] [b]New Languages:[/b] UI texts are now also available in Spanish, French and Italian!
 [*] [b]Difficulty Adjustments:[/b] All difficulty levels have been reworked according to community feedback. Easy difficulty is now much more beginner-friendly, while Medium and Hard have received some additional detail adjustments.
 [*] [b]Bonus Credits:[/b] Receive additional Credits for the Main Mission for each hour played!
 [*] [b]Stage Selection:[/b] On 'Easy' you can now select the stage you want to start from! All stages you have already played through are available as entry point.
 [*] [b]Improved Controller Support:[/b] With Steam Input you can now use all controllers supported by the Steam Client with Rigid Force Alpha! For further information please refer to the [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/steam_controller/getting_started_for_players]Steam documentation[/url].
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes & Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Rendering: Fixed a rendering bug that caused display problems in non-16:9 resolutions.
 [*] Balancing: All possibilities for infinite score farming have been removed.  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
 [*] Balancing: Some score values have been adjusted for Main Mission.
 [*] Balancing: Items now move a little slower and can be collected more easily.
 [*] General improvements of performance.
[/list]

If you have any feedback or questions please feel free to contact us via the forum or drop us a mail at support@com8com1.com!

Have a spooky Halloween...!

notes.title: Update: Patch to V1.0.3
notes.content:
The patch to V1.0.3 is now available! This release brings you the following improvements:

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Player HP display added on easy and medium difficulty level.
 [*] Arcade/Boss Rush: The current round can now be restarted comfortably via the pause menu.
 [*] The game now automatically switches to pause mode when controller connection is lost.
 [*] Enemies and destructible objects will no longer add to score during an ongoing boss battle.
 [*] Force Shards are now evenly distributed around their center in front/backward modes.
 [*] Added additional particle effects to sandfalls in Stage 3 (Vurgos).
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Interface scaling problems in window mode have been fixed.
 [*] Clicking message box buttons now works fine in all screen resolutions.
 [*] Arcade mode: Item containers are no longer blocked by energy bombs.
 [*] Various bug fixes for controllers implemented.
 [*] General improvements of performance and stability.
[/list]

And just in case you missed the previously released hotfixes: D-Pad controls for your controller as well as an option to adjust the deadzone of the analog stick have also been added.

We hope you will enjoy these improvements. If you have any feedback or support requests please feel free to contact us via the forum or drop us a mail at support@com8com1.com!
